verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query events, funnels, retention, flows, and session replays via natural language, plus a Query API for events/cohorts/user profiles, directly enabling an agent to answer growth questions from live data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server or API integration works reliably in practice, and no specific example of an agent answering a real growth question end-to-end.
